caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object positioned centrally on a plain, off-white or beige background. The object consists of a vertical rod topped with a small ornament or finial, with a central spindle supporting three evenly spaced, curved, prong-like arms perpendicular to the main shaft. The arms are stacked vertically, each extending outward in a slightly downward arch, forming a triangular, tiered arrangement. The entire structure is supported by three outwardly curving legs, providing stability at the base. The object appears to be rendered in shades of gray and black, suggesting a metallic texture. Below the object, small handwritten text is present. There are no other objects or features elsewhere in the background, which remains clear and unembellished.
